Overview

Where luxury
meets altitude

Brand Identity Logo Design Web Design Color System Typography Digital Assets

SkyFalcons is a premium aviation brokerage that connects clients worldwide with world-class aviation support services — covering aircraft sales, leasing, financing, maintenance, consulting, and private charter.

The brand needed to communicate the rare intersection of luxury and precision that defines private aviation. The identity had to feel exclusive without being inaccessible — refined and modern, yet bold enough to signal authority in a high-stakes industry.

The solution centers on a custom falcon symbol — drawn from the natural geometry of a falcon in full dive — angular, sharp, and unmistakably in motion. Paired with a clean serif wordmark and anchored in Sand Gold (#B4A060) against deep black, the identity reads as premium, mature, and globally confident.

Brand overview · SkyFalcons — Exclusive Services Identity in context
Symbol

The Falcon

The icon is derived from the natural anatomy of a diving falcon — the sharp beak, angled wings, and trail of motion lines. A 24° angle gives the mark its sense of velocity and forward momentum.
